newsitem.title: USA: FINOVA Group forms $100 mln fund with Calpers.
newsitem.headline: FINOVA Group forms $100 mln fund with Calpers.

text.p: California Public Employees Retirement System (Calpers) and FINOVA Group Inc said Monday they formed a $100 million investment fund with Doyle & Boissiere LLC, a San Francisco-based fund manager.

In a statement, the organizations said the fund will be known as "Doyle & Boissiere Fund I - a FINOVA Investment Alliance" and will provide equity and debt capital for the recovery and growth of underperforming midsize businesses.
Calpers will invest up to $75 million in the fund with the rest of the capital commitment to be provided by FINOVA and Doyle & Boissiere over the fund's initial three-year investment period.
